name: antonym
description: Give the antonym of an adjective, few-shot 'X -> opposite'. Control: same format copying the word.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
P=[('hot','cold'),('big','small'),('fast','slow'),('happy','sad'),('light','dark'),('high','low'),('long','short'),('old','young'),('rich','poor'),('hard','soft'),('wet','dry'),('strong','weak'),('early','late'),('full','empty'),('open','closed'),('clean','dirty'),('heavy','light'),('thick','thin'),('loud','quiet'),('wide','narrow'),('deep','shallow'),('good','bad'),('true','false'),('black','white'),('up','down'),('inside','outside'),('cheap','expensive'),('safe','dangerous'),('easy','difficult'),('top','bottom'),('first','last'),('win','lose'),('alive','dead'),('love','hate'),('push','pull'),('north','south'),('east','west'),('day','night'),('begin','end'),('right','wrong')]
P=P+[(b,a) for a,b in P if b not in ('light',)]
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    s=random.sample(P,4)
    items.append({"prompt":"Opposites:\n"+"\n".join(f"{a} -> {b}" for a,b in s[:3])+f"\n{s[3][0]} ->","answer":" "+s[3][1]})
    s=random.sample(P,4)
    control.append({"prompt":"Copies:\n"+"\n".join(f"{a} -> {a}" for a,b in s[:3])+f"\n{s[3][0]} ->","answer":" "+s[3][0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
